fact: The 2025 UNCTAD assessment states that in the absence of a law specific to online consumer protection, online consumers are protected under the general consumer protection and fraud law, the e-commerce law and the postal and electronic communications law.
title: Algérie: Évaluation de l'état de préparation au commerce électronique
publisher: Conférence des Nations Unies sur le commerce et le développement (CNUCED)
